meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以操控浏览器执行任务：导航到网页、点击元素、填写表单、截图、提取数据，并保持页面状态不变，能分步完成复杂操作。
howto.when: 当你要求访问网站、填写表单、截图、提取网页数据、测试网站或自动化浏览器操作，或提到“打开[网址]”、“点击”、“填写表单”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开百度，然后截图首页。
say.note: Claude 会启动浏览器访问百度并截图。

say.text: 点击搜索结果中的第一个链接。
say.note: Claude 会找到该链接并执行点击。

say.text: 提取当前页面的所有链接。
say.note: Claude 会运行脚本提取链接并返回结果。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can automate browser tasks: navigate to URLs, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and maintain page state across steps for complex workflows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to navigate, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test websites, automate browser actions, or use phrases like 'go to [url]', 'click on', 'fill out the form'.

say_en.text: Go to Baidu and take a screenshot of the homepage.
say_en.note: Claude launches browser, visits Baidu, and captures screenshot.

say_en.text: Click the first result in search results.
say_en.note: Claude locates and clicks the specified link.

say_en.text: Extract all links from the current page.
say_en.note: Claude runs a script to gather links and returns them.
